name: Elijah Galen Madrone
note: The lead.

name: Grace
note: The second lead. She invites him, loves him, and tells him to go home.

name: His mother
note: Never named. After the stroke she has one word, "Barry."

name: Melody
note: His half-sister, in Miami. One phone call and a blocked number.

name: David McGrath
note: His oldest friend, behind the bar at the Bear Flag.

name: Ray McGrath
note: David's father. Club soda, the framed prayer, the horses.

name: His grandmother
note: The madrones and the Fisher stove.

name: His father, Manny and the uncle
note: His father is dead about ten years. Manny has the next place over.

name: Nate and Wes
note: The band, Second Crop.

name: Devendra
note: Senior and calm at Claypot. Loser cooks.

name: The realtors, and Kelsey, Carol and Mateo
note: The toast, and the three people who were let go.

name: Linda's granddaughter
note: The Hollis girl. She is how the video gets out.

name: Ruby Roth-Jones
note: Twenty-four. He made the lamp that talks.

name: The Architect
note: She built it without asking, and works on whether it asks first.

name: Gus
note: The robot arms, the bus line, "Your choice."

name: Aaron Bidwell
note: The one man behind Claypot, the land companies and the Memphis platform.

name: Bidwell's reader
note: The person who reads for him.

name: The old man on the curb
note: Twenty dollars and the food bank.

name: The others on the road
note: Trent, Earl, the woman in Tulsa, Pruitt and the rest.

name: Marta Okonkwo
note: The welder. "We'll see."

name: Lou
note: He grows the food, and he says the two things that turn Elijah.

name: Denny Osei
note: Two ladders, both moved. The channel is his.

name: Curtis
note: The fence, the basement, the route.

name: Tyler
note: Nineteen when he arrives. "I used Rod Code."

name: Priya
note: The beds, the pencil, thirty centimeters.

name: Reuben Vance
note: The part of the machine that runs on paper.

name: Frank Kowalski
note: The hardware store and the bell.

name: Wren
note: The Sunday circle and the candles.

name: Patricia
note: Policy director for the CSA network. She has been using it all along.

name: Rosa
note: The converted garage. "Pass the lamb."

name: Irene Calder
note: Walt's widow. The forty acres.

name: The girl with the laptop, and the mother from Redding
note: Two strangers near the end.

name: Ricardo
note: Not in the book yet. He comes from CT's dictation of the morning of 19 November: a staunch anti-capitalist, with a girlfriend who agrees with him. "Ricardo" is his first try at the name, and he says "Carl" once.

name: The leader of the farm
note: Not in the book yet. He comes from CT's dictation of the morning of 19 November: the one who stops the argument over money. Who he is has not been decided. The co-op has no leader on the page.
